❓ Frequently asked questions

What counts as needs vs wants?

Needs: housing, food, transport, insurance, minimum debt payments. Wants: dining out, hobbies, subscriptions, travel. Savings: emergency fund, investing, extra debt payoff.

What if my needs exceed 50%?

Common in expensive cities. Aim to trim wants first, then look at bigger levers like housing or transport.

Is 50/30/20 a strict rule?

No — it is a starting framework. Adjust the split to your goals, e.g. 50/20/30 to save aggressively.
